description_en: Feeling hot or having a high temperature
advice_en: Drink plenty of water and rest in a cool place. If fever stays above 39°C or more than 3 days, visit a clinic.
description_kriol: Yu body feelim hot, laik yu gat fever.
advice_kriol: Drink plenti watta an rest la kol ples. Go klinik if fever go high o stap moa den tri dei.

advice_en: Use tissues gently, drink warm fluids, and keep warm. See a doctor if nose blocks for more than a week.
advice_kriol: Yus tisyu lait lait, drink hot watta, an kepa yu body warm. Go klinik if nose block longtaim.

description_en: Pain in the head or temples
advice_en: Rest in a quiet, dark place and drink water. Avoid loud sounds or screens. Seek care if headaches are frequent.
description_kriol: Yu hed bin pain o laik bom bom.
common_causes_kriol: Stress o no drink watta o flu
advice_kriol: Rest long kwaet ples, drink watta, no luk phone o lisin big nois. Go klinik if hed pain kam bak plenti taim.

advice_en: Sip warm tea with honey and avoid smoking or dusty air. Visit a doctor if you cough blood or over 2 weeks.
description_kriol: Yu cough plenti from flu o dust.
advice_kriol: Drink hot tea wit honey, no smoke, no go dusty ples. Go klinik if cough stap moa den tu wik o gat blud.

description_en: Pain or irritation in the throat
advice_en: Gargle warm salt water and drink fluids. Avoid shouting. Seek help if throat pain makes swallowing hard.
advice_kriol: Gargle wit salt watta, drink plenti, no shout. Go klinik if troat pain mek yu no can swalow.

description_en: Pain or discomfort in the belly
advice_en: Eat light food and avoid spicy meals. Rest and stay hydrated. Go to the clinic if pain is severe or lasts long.
description_kriol: Bel bin pain from kai kai o sik.
advice_kriol: Kai kai smol lite kai kai, no spicy, rest an drink watta. Go klinik if bel pain strong o stap longtaim.

advice_en: Sit or lie down and take slow breaths. Drink water and avoid standing quickly. See a doctor if it repeats often.
advice_kriol: Sidown, breathe slou, drink watta, no stan ap kwik. Go klinik if spin kam bak plenti taim.

advice_en: Sleep early, eat nutritious food, and take short breaks. If tiredness doesn’t go away, get a health check.
description_kriol: Yu feelim taiya o no gat energy.
common_causes_kriol: Stress o no slip gud o anemia
advice_kriol: Slip gud, kai kai propali kai kai, tek smol brek. Go klinik if taiya no go wei.

advice_en: Sit upright and take slow, deep breaths. Get fresh air and seek urgent care if breathing gets worse.
advice_kriol: Sidown straight, breathe slou, go out fo fresh air. Go klinik kwik if breath kam moa bad.

description_en: Swelling in one or both legs
advice_en: Rest and raise your legs above heart level. Avoid standing too long. Visit clinic if swelling increases.
description_kriol: Leg bin swel from sik o heart.
advice_kriol: Rest, lift leg lilbit up, no stan longtaim. Go klinik if leg swel moa.

description_en: Pain or tightness in the chest
advice_en: Stop activity and rest. Seek medical help immediately if pain spreads to arm or jaw.
description_kriol: Yu chest bin pain o tait.
advice_kriol: Stop wok, rest, an go klinik kwik if pain go long arm o jaw.

description_en: Pain in lower or upper back
advice_en: Stretch gently, use warm compress, and avoid lifting heavy things. Visit doctor if pain lasts more than a week.
description_kriol: Bak bin sore from lif hevi o wok longtaim.
advice_kriol: Stretch smol, put hot watta botol, no lif hevi samting. Go klinik if bak pain stap longtaim.

advice_en: Use lotion or cream, keep skin clean, and wear soft clothes. If it worsens, see a doctor.
advice_kriol: Yus lotion o cream, keep skin kleen, wea soft klos. Go klinik if itchy kam moa bad.

advice_en: Avoid scratching and keep skin dry. Use mild cream. Go to clinic if rash spreads or gets painful.
advice_kriol: No scratch, keep skin dry, yus soft cream. Go klinik if rash go moa o pain.

advice_en: Take small sips of water and rest. Avoid solid food until you feel better. See clinic if vomiting often.
advice_kriol: Drink watta smol smol, rest, no kai kai hevi. Go klinik if spiu plenti o no stop.

description_en: Feeling sick or want to vomit
advice_en: Eat bland food and rest. Take deep breaths and avoid strong smells.
advice_kriol: Kai kai smol lite kai kai, rest, breathe slou, no smell strong kai kai.

description_en: Pain inside or around the ear
advice_en: Keep ear dry, avoid loud sounds, and don’t insert anything. Go to doctor if pain lasts.
advice_kriol: Kepa ear dry, no put samting insaid, no lisin loud nois. Go klinik if pain stap longtaim.

description_en: Pain or irritation in the eye
advice_en: Rest your eyes, avoid screens, and use clean water if dusty. Seek help if eyes get red or swollen.
description_kriol: Yu eye bin sore o red.
advice_kriol: Rest eye, no luk phone, wash wit kleen watta if dust. Go klinik if eye red o swel.

advice_en: Rest eyes and check your vision soon. Avoid driving until vision clears.
advice_kriol: Rest eye, go klinik fo eye chek, no draiv til yu see klia.

advice_en: Stretch gently, rest joints, and apply warmth. If joints swell or lock, visit clinic.
advice_kriol: Stretch smol, rest joint, put hot watta botol. Go klinik if joint swel o lock.

description_en: Excess sweating even when not hot
advice_en: Drink plenty of water and rest in a cool place. Go to clinic if sweating comes with chest pain.
advice_kriol: Drink plenti watta, rest la kol ples. Go klinik if swet kam wit chest pain.

advice_en: Keep warm with a blanket and drink warm fluids. Visit doctor if chills don’t stop.
description_kriol: Yu body bin kol kol an shake.
advice_kriol: Kepa warm wit blanket, drink hot tea. Go klinik if kol shake no stop.

advice_en: Eat small meals often and drink fluids. Try fruit or soup if solid food feels heavy.
advice_kriol: Kai kai smol smol plenti taim, drink watta. Kai fruit o soup if kai kai hevi fo yu.

advice_en: Eat fruits, vegetables, and drink water. Walk a little every day to help movement.
common_causes_kriol: No fiber o no drink watta
advice_kriol: Kai kai fruit an veg, drink plenti watta, waka smol evri dei fo help go toilet.

advice_en: Drink water with rehydration salts. Avoid oily food and dairy until recovery.
advice_kriol: Drink watta wit salt mix, no kai kai oil kai kai o milk til yu beta.

advice_en: Drink lots of water and avoid coffee or alcohol. See doctor for antibiotics if burning continues.
description_kriol: Yu pee bin hot o pain.
advice_kriol: Drink plenti watta, no drink coffee o grog. Go klinik fo medisn if pee still hot.

advice_en: Rest, stretch lightly, and drink fluids. A warm bath can help muscles relax.
advice_kriol: Rest, stretch smol, drink watta. Hot bath help yu masol relax.

advice_en: Avoid screens before bed, keep a sleep routine, and relax your mind. See doctor if sleeplessness lasts weeks.
common_causes_kriol: Stress o drink coffee tu moch
advice_kriol: No luk phone bifo bed, rest mind, slip same taim evri dei. Go klinik if no slip fo longtaim.

advice_en: Practice deep breathing, take short walks, and talk to someone you trust. Get help if anxiety stops daily life.
advice_kriol: Breathe deep, waka smol, tok wit fren yu trust. Go klinik if wari stop yu laif.

description_en: Expelling air through the nose repeatedly
advice_en: Rest and avoid dusty areas. Use tissues and wash hands often to stop spreading germs.
advice_kriol: Rest, no go dusty ples, yus tisyu, wash han plenti taim.

description_en: Not enough water in the body
advice_en: Drink water or oral rehydration salts. Avoid long sun exposure. Seek help if you feel dizzy or weak.
advice_kriol: Drink plenti watta o salt watta, no stap long hot san. Go klinik if yu feel weak o spin.
